sentences.text: Huanghetitan is a genus of basal titanosauriform sauropod dinosaur that lived in what is now Gansu, China.
The type species, Huanghetitan liujiaxiaensis, was described by You et al. in 2006 from fragmentary fossils found in the Lanzhou Basin.
In 2019, Gregory S. Paul suggested that the second species, H. ruyangensis, could have weighed between 45 and 55 metric tons.
A second species, H. ruyangensis, was described in 2007 from fossils found in Ruyang County, Henan Province.
A family named Huangetitanidae was proposed for Huanghetitan in 2007, but later analyses found it to be polyphyletic.
The time range for Huanghetitan is estimated from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 113.2 million years ago.
Recent cladistic analysis suggests H. ruyangensis is unlikely to be closely related to H. liujiaxiaensis and may require a new genus name.
